title: Service account RDP logon
logs: 02:10:40 EventID=1 Host=SRV-DB User=svc_backup Image=cmd.exe CommandLine="cmd.exe /c whoami /all"
02:11:15 EventID=1 Host=SRV-DB User=svc_backup Image=net.exe CommandLine="net group \"Domain Admins\" /domain"
question: A service account logs in over RDP at 02:10. How do you assess it?
explanation: Service accounts should not log on interactively. An RDP logon (type 10) at 02:10 is unusual, and whoami followed by Domain Admins enumeration is hands-on-keyboard discovery. Treat it as a probable compromise: check source 10.0.5.77, isolate SRV-DB, disable or reset the account, and scope other hosts. Confirm with the backup team only if the logs stay ambiguous.
